summary.result: The ratios of irrigation load to total inflow load for TN and TP were 88 %, and the ratios of surface outflow load to total outflow load for TN and TP were over 90 %, indicating that total nutrient load may be greatly affected by water management.
summary.background: The objective of this research was to investigate concentration and load of nutrients such as total nitrogen (TN), nitrate nitrogen ( $NO_3$ -N) total phosphorous (TP), and phosphate phosphorous ( $PO_4$ -P) in a 23.4-ha paddy fields watershed with river water source.
summary.method: Mean flow-weighted concentrations of TN and TP in irrigation water were 2.8 and 0.15 mg/L, respectively, higher than those in the area irrigated from a large reservoir or a pumping station.
